entries.title: Mat Rack and Slant-Board Preparation Zone
entries.description: One static mat and slant-board preparation zone for the original fitness stretch-area program. Three complete existing models at original unit scale and identity orientation: full twin-peg hanging mat rack with both original whole mats at the rear-left, complete pierced fixed slant board on the front floor, and the original full-height changing locker at the rear-right with its fixed open door. The existing sports locker is reused whole, not renamed or counted as a new fitness prop. No mat is extracted from its rack or claimed compatible with other equipment. Whole raw GLB POSITION/NORMAL/index buffers, internal hierarchy and per-face PBR remain unchanged. Only one connected floor and cutaway boundary are new scene-only geometry. All original finite ground soles sit on the floor, the complete envelopes are mutually separated, and five conservative empty strips are connected. This is equipment storage/preparation beside a fixed board, not the old kettlebell shelf/mat exercise corner, sports rest scene, or a promise of a practical stretching station. One scene, zero new independent models. No mat removal, unfolding, elastic deformation, door motion, use demonstration, body fit, exercise benefit, therapeutic effect, human ergonomics, loading, anti-tip, locker security, installation or fitness safety is claimed.

entries.title: Laboratory Sink and Empty Equipment Cabinet Corner
entries.description: One static laboratory equipment-corner scene, bounded to an open sink table and empty generic storage cabinet. The whole original laboratory sink table retains its continuous thick offset basin and real inner floor, complete side deck, one five-rib drainboard with four surface channels, both open end trestles with all four soles, rear stretcher, original fixed angular tap exterior and splash panel. Its small dark drain patch remains only coplanar material, not a drain hole or plumbing system. Beside it stands the entire original narrow pantry cabinet with all original upper shelves, recessed plinth, closed lower door, handle and original hinge-node hierarchy. That existing generic cabinet remains the same asset, not a newly modelled reagent cabinet; specialist bottle fixtures, reagent compatibility and protection are not supplied. All original local POSITION/NORMAL/index bytes, four plus three opaque PBR materials and internal hierarchy remain unchanged. Only whole-instance unit-scale translations and one finite floor are authored. Both complete floor footprints are grounded and the full station bounds have a positive quarter-metre gap, not a claimed seamless bench. This is not the old microscope/vial observation corner, and not the old stove, sink-cabinet and cookware kitchen hearth renamed: the original open-frame basin and an empty tall shelving cabinet form a different bounded equipment-storage layout. One scene and zero new independent models. No bottle-count or colour variants. No actual washing, water flow, tap internal passage, chemicals, samples, ventilation, sterile or biological/experimental performance, experiment steps, load or equipment/laboratory safety.
